profileText: a Representative from Virginia; born in Tampa, Hillsborough County, Fla., June 18, 1971; graduated from Bishop Moore Catholic High School, Orlando, Fla., 1989; B.A. Boston University, Boston, Mass., 1993; B.S., Old Dominion University, Norfolk, Va., 2011; M.S. Vanderbilt University, Nashville, Tenn., 2012; United States Navy, 1993-2003; nurse practitioner; adjunct faculty; member of the Virginia state senate, 2020-2023; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighteenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2023-present).
